facts.text: W Sydney rises over Darling Harbour with the undulating lines of a futuristic exterior.
facts.excerpt: Rising over Darling Harbour, W Sydney instantly captures the eye with the undulating lines of its futuristic exterior

facts.text: No two rooms are alike; they have floor-to-ceiling windows with views over Darling Harbour or the city.
facts.excerpt: with no two rooms alike, embracing the asymmetry with a sleek, modern décor and expansive views over Darling Harbour or the city through floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: Room interiors take their palette from the surrounding marine environment.
facts.excerpt: The interior palette of our luxury hotel rooms is inspired by the surrounding marine environment

facts.text: The interiors draw on the free-spirited Australian larrikin.
facts.excerpt: the notion of Australia’s free-spirited Larrikin shines through W Sydney’s luxe yet unconventional interiors

facts.text: Penthouse I on Level 27 channels the HMAS Onslow submarine and has a crescent-shaped bedroom and a circular bathtub overlooking the harbour.
facts.excerpt: The bedroom boasts a unique crescent shape, an adjoining walk-in robe, and a second circular bathtub overlooking the harbour.

facts.text: The rooftop WET Deck has a heated infinity pool with 180-degree views of Darling Harbour.
facts.excerpt: WET Deck features a 30m heated infinity pool with 180° views of Darling Harbour.

facts.text: The indoor WET pool on Level 22 has a waratah-inspired mosaic mural.
facts.excerpt: Take a dip inside WET® pool and rejuvenate in style as a waratah-inspired mural embellished with mosaic tiles creates a stunning backdrop to swim laps or sit back and relax.

facts.text: AWAY Spa has five treatment rooms, manicure and pedicure pods, a relaxation zone, a sauna, a steam room and a beauty bar.
facts.excerpt: AWAY Spa is designed for solo or social experiences, featuring five treatment rooms, manicure and pedicure pods, a relaxation zone, a sauna, a steam room, and a beauty bar.

facts.text: 29/30 is a two-storey rooftop bar at the hotel's crown above Darling Harbour.
facts.excerpt: 29/30 sits at the hotel’s crown, a luminous rooftop bar above Darling Harbour.

facts.text: One-, two- and three-bedroom Studio apartments with full gourmet kitchens are designed for longer stays.
facts.excerpt: One-, two- and three-bedroom Studio luxury apartments are designed for longer stays.

facts.text: A scenic waterfront walking trail leads from the hotel area via Pyrmont and the Barangaroo headland toward Sydney's icons.
facts.excerpt: follow the scenic waterfront walking trail that winds its way from neighbouring Pyrmont and the Barangaroo headland

facts.text: Every guestroom and venue has harbour or city views.
facts.excerpt: offering harbour or city views from each guestroom and venue

facts.text: Valet parking is limited and must be pre-booked.
facts.excerpt: Limited valet parking is available for in-house hotel guests

facts.text: Rooms do not permit rollaway beds.
facts.excerpt: No, the rooms at W Sydney do not permit rollaway beds.
